Helping animals Breathe Better to Live Better.

For over 20 years our sole focus has been on animals’ lung health. We work with veterinarians, animal behaviorists, and clinical researchers to make innovative products that are specifically designed to meet the unique needs of animals and their parents.

Trudell Animal Health is a division of Trudell Medical International (est. 1922), a global leader in designing and manufacturing the highest quality aerosol drug delivery and lung health devices for the management of asthma and COPD in humans.
Our devices are Made in Canada with parts from Canada and the United States.

We breathe life into products for healthier pets and the well-being of families.
